passages.aquarium: The City Aquarium open hours are 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. daily. General admission is $18 for adults and $10 for children under 12. Shark feedings take place on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 2:00 p.m. Parking in the north lot is free for members.
passages.workshop: The woodworking guild meets every Saturday morning in Studio 4. Safety glasses and closed-toe shoes are required at all times. Lathes may only be operated after passing the introductory safety check. Monthly dues are $35, payable on the first of each month.
passages.shuttle: The downtown connector shuttle departs every 20 minutes from Central Station. Weekday service runs until 11:00 p.m., while weekend service ends at 8:00 p.m. Transfers to the light rail are free with a digital pass. Bicycles are allowed on the rear rack only.

passages.bakery: The Maple Street Bakery opens at 6:30 a.m. Tuesday through Sunday. Sourdough loaves cost $8 each, and croissants are $4. Cake orders require 48 hours advance notice. The kitchen uses organic flour from Riverbend Mill.
passages.clinic: The community health clinic provides walk-in flu vaccinations on Wednesdays. Copays for insured patients are $15, while self-pay visits are $25. Parking validation is available at the reception desk. Minors must be accompanied by an adult guardian.
passages.library: The local branch library loans laptops for three hours per visit. Late returns incur a fee of $5 per day. Study rooms can be reserved online up to one week in advance. The annual book sale takes place in October.

passages.museum: The Heritage Museum charges $12 for adult tickets and $6 for seniors. Audio guides are available at the front desk for an extra $3. Flash photography is strictly prohibited inside the main gallery. Free admission is offered on the first Friday of each month.
passages.gym: The fitness center locker rooms are closed for cleaning daily between 1:00 p.m. and 2:00 p.m. Towel rental is $2 per visit. Guest passes cost $10 per day. Squash court bookings must be cancelled at least 2 hours before the scheduled slot.
passages.ferry: The harbor ferry runs every 30 minutes from Pier 7. Adult one-way fare is $7, and children ride free on weekends. Pets must remain in an approved carrier. The upper deck is closed during high winds.

passages.theater: The Civic Theater box office opens at noon on performance days. Student rush tickets are $20 with valid identification. Concessions accept card payments only. Late seating occurs only during designated applause breaks.
passages.park: Riverview Park pavilion rentals cost $50 per afternoon block. Charcoal grills are available on a first-come basis. Amplified sound requires a special city permit. The park gates close promptly at sunset.
passages.hotel: The harbor inn serves complimentary continental breakfast from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. Overnight valet parking is $30 per vehicle. The indoor heated pool closes at 10:00 p.m. Check-out time is 11:00 a.m.
